config_diff:
diff --git a/configs/default.yaml b/configs/default.yaml
index 1532370..2bd14b0 100644
--- a/configs/default.yaml
+++ b/configs/default.yaml
@@ -93,7 +93,7 @@ resense:
     floor_verify_tolerance: 0.5    # m, allowed deviation of the far side base from its near-range height
     floor_verify_min_points: 5     # side points per bin for the bin to count
     floor_verify_max_range: 250.0  # m, how far the verification is attempted
-    axis_joint_fit: false          # 19.10 (K2, off): joint least-squares axis of the near rail-pair midpoints and every tunnel-boundary segment (track.joint_axis_fit): tangent, curvature and a curvature step at axis_joint_knot from one fit, grown outward; off = as before
+    axis_joint_fit: true           # 19.10 (K2, off): joint least-squares axis of the near rail-pair midpoints and every tunnel-boundary segment (track.joint_axis_fit): tangent, curvature and a curvature step at axis_joint_knot from one fit, grown outward; off = as before
     axis_joint_knot: 60.0          # 19.10: m, X from which the curvature may change (C1 piecewise axis); 0 = a single quadratic
     axis_joint_step_sigma: 0.001   # 19.10: 1/m, prior SD of that curvature step
     axis_joint_min_far_bins: 4     # 19.10: boundary bins beyond the knot needed to fit a step
@@ -103,10 +103,10 @@ resense:
     axis_joint_grow_start: 40.0    # 19.10: m, first range of the outward growth
     axis_joint_grow_step: 16.0     # 19.10: m, growth step
     axis_joint_min_segment: 3      # 19.10: bins a boundary segment needs to take part
-    axis_joint_range: true         # 20.10: with axis_joint_fit, the trusted range from the joint fit too (v3); false = axis shape only, range policy as before (v4)
-    axis_joint_min_curvature: 0.0  # 19.10 (v5, off; 1/m; with axis_joint_fit and axis_joint_range false): > 0 = the estimator without the joint fit runs on its own state and is the output; the joint fit's shape replaces its axis shape only on frames with |curvature| >= this (a curve as it sees it); 0 = off (v4)
-    axis_joint_reach_cap: false    # 19.10 (v5b, off; needs axis_joint_min_curvature > 0): on the frames with the joint shape, the trusted range also capped at the boundaries' reach along that axis + axis_valid_margin
-    walls_smoothing_distance: 0.0  # 19.10 (K1, off): m; > 0: the axis EMA exponent and rate limits per distance travelled (travel / this, at least walls_smoothing_min_k, at most the frame periods); unknown speed as before
+    axis_joint_range: false        # 20.10: with axis_joint_fit, the trusted range from the joint fit too (v3); false = axis shape only, range policy as before (v4)
+    axis_joint_min_curvature: 0.0001 # 19.10 (v5, off; 1/m; with axis_joint_fit and axis_joint_range false): > 0 = the estimator without the joint fit runs on its own state and is the output; the joint fit's shape replaces its axis shape only on frames with |curvature| >= this (a curve as it sees it); 0 = off (v4)
+    axis_joint_reach_cap: true     # 19.10 (v5b, off; needs axis_joint_min_curvature > 0): on the frames with the joint shape, the trusted range also capped at the boundaries' reach along that axis + axis_valid_margin
+    walls_smoothing_distance: 1.5  # 19.10 (K1, off): m; > 0: the axis EMA exponent and rate limits per distance travelled (travel / this, at least walls_smoothing_min_k, at most the frame periods); unknown speed as before
     walls_smoothing_min_k: 0.05    # 19.10 (K1): lower bound of that exponent
     walls_smoothing_standstill_speed: 1.0  # 19.10 (K1): m/s; no speed estimate and a texture profile without any change count as standing while the last confident estimate is at most this
     walls_smoothing_standstill_max: 60.0  # 19.10 (K1): s; that standing rule at most this long in a row
